name: list
description: List files and directories in a folder. Skips hidden and .gitignored entries. Optional glob filter; recursive for subfolders.

arguments.name: glob
arguments.desc: Glob on paths as shown, e.g. "*.md" or "src/**/*.rs".

arguments.name: max_entries
arguments.desc: Most entries to return; capped by the server limit.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Directory to list; omit or "." for the top.

name: read
description: Read a text file, optionally only lines start_line..end_line (1-based, inclusive). Small PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images come back as images; other binary files are reported, not returned.

arguments.name: end_line
arguments.desc: Last line to return, inclusive (default: end of file).

name: search
description: Search text files for a regular expression; returns path, line number and line for each match. Optional start path, glob filter, ignore_case.

arguments.name: glob
arguments.desc: Glob on paths as shown, e.g. "*.rs".

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Directory or file to search; omit for everything.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.desc: Regular expression (Rust regex syntax) matched against each line.

name: stat
description: Describe a path: kind (file, dir, symlink), size, modified time, line count for text files, image type for images.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to describe; "." for the top.
